Frequently asked questions

Is Vanchiglia safe?

Wandroz currently rates Vanchiglia in Turin, Italy as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz at night. At night, Vanchiglia is rated as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
